artifact_policy: All new artifacts end in _d4b; frozen artifacts, reserves, the paper, and the explainer are immutable.

c1_group_library.carrier_period: median interval between analytic-signal phase upcrossings inside the retained run
c1_group_library.central_height: maximum of twice the Hilbert-envelope amplitude
c1_group_library.clustering: deterministic farthest-first medoids on robustly standardized carrier period, central height, cycle count, and nine normalized envelope ordinates
c1_group_library.declustering: one group per contiguous threshold run; runs separated by less than one peak period are merged
c1_group_library.occurrence_interval: 95% central Gamma-Poisson posterior predictive interval with Jeffreys shape 1/2 for one exposure hour

c2_embedding.amendment_before_test: The original fixed 48 s window truncated a TRAIN-derived 82 s medoid. Before any TEST materialization it was replaced by a variable window containing the complete retained group plus the already-frozen 16 s margins.
c2_embedding.blend_window: raised-cosine crossfade at both target-record boundaries
c2_embedding.spectral_distortion_metric: positive increase in energy above 2.5 times the spectral peak frequency, divided by composite total variance
c2_embedding.target_window: complete retained threshold run with a 16 s source-record margin before and after

c3_entry_strata.comparison: held-out unconditional extended-period entry-state samples at the same 320 s timestamp
c3_entry_strata.energy_reserve: 1/4 - (v^2/2 + x^2/2 - x^4/4) in the nondimensional softening model

c4_response.isotonic_method: weighted pooled-adjacent-violators on binary capsize outcomes within shape and entry stratum

c5_rate_validation.capture_criterion: The 95% encounter-conditioned predictive interval contains the realized matched unconditional capsize count.

c6_observability.evaluation: one-shot held-out TEST preludes; all fitting and reliability-bin edges use calibration preludes only
c6_observability.model: unpenalized logistic regression with standardized continuous inputs and an intercept

predictors.entry_only: roll, roll rate, danger margin, energy reserve
predictors.group_only: carrier period, scaled central height, cycle count, and nine envelope-shape ordinates

c6_observability.predictions_verbatim: (i) both will substantially exceed either alone; (ii) group-only will exceed entry-only; (iii) if (c) is sharp (AUC >= 0.80) the encounter channel is confirmed valuable and quantifies the Upwave sensing target; if (c) is weak even with the full group known, motion-plus-encounter observability is jointly insufficient in this model and the program's negative answer is complete.

c7_uncertainty.decomposition: one-source-at-a-time bootstrap variance for group rates, entry distribution, and response map, plus their jointly resampled predictive interval

experiment: D4b critical wave groups with natural initial conditions
status: preregistered before any D4b TEST-seed materialization
test_requirements: synthetic hand-placed groups recover count and parameters
embedding preserves every pre-blend byte and group parameters within tolerance
bisection recovers a deterministic known threshold
fresh TEST ranges are disjoint from every ledgered TEST range and both reserves
